independent_method: Load only depth_mm and source_index plus old private selected masks; reconstruct native xyz as (rays*native_mm) @ R.T + t; independently project with installed OpenCV projectPoints and compare all five emitted quantile summaries; no new reference-mask decoding.
aggregation_caution: Selected point rows repeat physical pixels across arms/objects; not independent physical accuracy observations.

static_review.source_binding: All selected native source_index values within bounds; exact color camera-Z float32 equality to archived aligned measurements; identical native point set on both projections.
static_review.rotation_direction: Depth-to-color convention: recorded row-major matrix, xyz_color=xyz_depth@R.T+t; nearest_SO3 replaces only R in a shadow projection.
static_review.calibration_provenance: SDK bag writer depthProfile.getExtrinsicTo(colorProfile); SDK bag reader replays recorded arrays. Playback agreement is same-source calibration agreement.
static_review.temporal_contract: Frozen original RGB ordinal and unique nearest depth timestamp retained. Color timestamp precedes depth by 1-2 ms; no future frame or exposure-midpoint correction added.
static_review.change_scope: Verified DS1-DS4 immutable lock, all frozen DS5 source/config/reviews, sealed measurements and cohort source hashes before and after; only this review written by this independent check.

limitations: Exact numerical source binding and reprojection do not establish physical calibration accuracy.
Nearest SO(3) is structural sensitivity, not a certified correction and not inserted into the measurements.
Reference silhouettes and camera-Z medians do not identify underwater physical surface ownership.
Timestamp proximity does not establish exposure midpoint synchronization or physical moving-surface registration.
Hardware cause of anomalous native values, sensor valid range and true physical distances remain UNKNOWN.
